description: Reproduce GitHub #158 with failing tests, fix new-maximum routing after index splits, validate recovered page chains/global key order/duplicates/reachable page count, and document behavior for damaged stores. Deliver via isolated worktree and PR.

comments.text: TDD RED: index-tree right-edge assertions returned page 0; 600 increasing one-key transactions made committed keys unroutable after splits; synthetic recovered overlap/duplicate map omitted keys. GREEN: right-edge routing now selects the largest boundary; recovery validates chain reachability/order/uniqueness, canonically repairs damaged maps using newest append locator, queues repaired pages for persistence, and resumes data offset bookkeeping. Focused Olivine: 306 tests + 23 properties; full suite: 2,838 tests + 158 properties + 17 doctests; format and Credo strict clean; Dialyzer 0 errors.

Cold review found automatic repair unsafe: compaction can reverse locator recency, and clears can leave a unique stale copy that union repair would resurrect; selective loading also hid orphan/missing-page-0 snapshot corruption. Reworked recovery to fail closed with structured corrupt_index reasons and validate self-contained snapshots before filtering. Final gates after rework: 311 Olivine tests + 23 properties; full suite 2,842 tests + 158 properties + 17 doctests; format, Credo strict, and Dialyzer all green.

Third cold review found fail-open recovery for missing/cyclic predecessor history plus embedded page-ID mismatch. Added red reproductions, then made history traversal reject absent, repeated, or non-descending versions and validate map IDs before reconstruction. Gates: Olivine 315 tests + 23 properties; full suite 2,846 tests + 158 properties + 17 doctests; format, strict Credo, and Dialyzer clean.

Fourth cold review exposed a valid range-clear history falsely rejected because recovery followed stale snapshot pointers. Added a red five-page snapshot/newer 0->3->4 chain regression, removed speculative traversal from unreachable historical pages, and documented/tested early termination once the live chain is resolved. Final gates now: Olivine 317 tests + 23 properties; full suite 2,848 tests + 158 properties + 17 doctests; format, strict Credo, Dialyzer all green.

Release cold review found two complementary historical topologies: stale pages deleted by a newer chain must not be chased, while newly split siblings cached in newer blocks must be followed once an older root reaches them. Added red regressions for deletion, non-leftmost split, and cached-live-chain closure. Recovery now resolves only needed IDs transitively against the accumulated newest-page view after each block. Final gates: Olivine 319 tests + 23 properties; full 2,848 tests + 158 properties + 17 doctests; format, Credo strict, Dialyzer green.

title: Fix Olivine right-edge routing and reject corrupt recovered indexes
